name: Tesla Robotaxi
sub: FSD-powered ridehail active in Austin and Miami
about: Tesla’s autonomous ridehail service using Tesla vehicles and FSD software.
model: Direct ridehail revenue; long-term owner-vehicle network vision.
deployment: Austin and Miami reported active; Dallas/Houston planned.
metrics: Cities: Austin, Dallas, Houston, plus Tampa and Orlando added 21 July 2026. Pricing history: $4.20 flat at June 2025 launch, $1 base plus $1 per mile from July 2025, base fare tripled March 2026. Remote operators can take direct control at low speed.
signal: First production Cybercab built February 2026 with volume production from April, per EPA filings the most efficient EV yet at 165 Wh/mi and ~293 miles range; supervised FSD fleet crossed 10B cumulative miles in May 2026.

sources.title: Electrek: Tesla adds Robotaxi in Tampa and Orlando as Austin stalls at 17 cars
